claim_scope: strict frozen external evaluation on a locally frozen non-author-equivalent CipherSpectrum split

bootstrap.sampling: paired class-stratified resampling with replacement; identical sampled rows for both methods

setting_rule.WIN: DeltaUFAR < 0 with 95% CI upper bound < 0, unless Delta Known FRR has 95% CI lower bound > 0
setting_rule.TRADEOFF: UFAR point estimate improves but Delta Known FRR has 95% CI lower bound > 0, or Known FRR improves while UFAR worsens
setting_rule.NO GAIN: DeltaUFAR improvement is not supported because its 95% CI crosses zero
setting_rule.HARM: DeltaUFAR > 0 with 95% CI lower bound > 0 and Known FRR lacks statistically supported compensation

cross_setting_rule.A: at least two WIN settings, no positive DeltaUFAR point estimate, and no setting with statistically supported Known-FRR harm
cross_setting_rule.B: UFAR improvement is primarily accompanied by statistically supported Known-FRR increase, or the converse operating-point exchange
cross_setting_rule.C: no setting has statistically supported UFAR improvement and there is no statistically supported harm pattern
cross_setting_rule.D: at least two settings have statistically supported UFAR harm without statistically supported Known-FRR compensation
cross_setting_rule.E: the sign of DeltaUFAR differs across Low, Medium, and High or remaining outcomes are materially mixed
